name: Korabl'-Sputnik-4
about: Korabl'-Sputnik-4 (1961 THE 1), a crewed vehicle (Vostok3A), launched 1961 Mar  9. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1961 Mar  9), held fixed
GCAT gives no site; the point stands in for the programme's usual landing or recovery area, from memory
